label: Genetic Peroxisomal Disorders
summary: Zellweger spectrum, X-ALD, RCDP, Refsum, and single-enzyme diseases; where every current treatment originated

label: Cancer
summary: prostate, colorectal, lymphoma, and glioblastoma tumors lean on peroxisomal fat metabolism and antioxidant capacity
description: Tumors are metabolically demanding and need both fuel and protection from oxidative damage. Several tumor types appear to lean on peroxisomal fat metabolism and peroxisomal antioxidant capacity to supply both.

parts.label: Prostate cancer
parts.text: the most developed example — AMACR is elevated distinctively enough to be used as a routine diagnostic marker in pathology labs ([Luo et al., Cancer Res 2002](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=Luo+AMACR+prostate+cancer+Cancer+Research+2002); [Rubin et al., JAMA 2002](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=Rubin+AMACR+prostate+cancer+JAMA+2002); [Kong 2020](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/molecular-biosciences/articles/10.3389/fmolb.2020.00153/full)).
left: **AMACR ([Lipid Breakdown](#/mechanisms/lipid-breakdown)):** an established diagnostic marker for prostate cancer, elevated enough to be used routinely in pathology labs ([Luo et al., Cancer Res 2002](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=Luo+AMACR+prostate+cancer+Cancer+Research+2002); [Rubin et al., JAMA 2002](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=Rubin+AMACR+prostate+cancer+JAMA+2002)), and separately linked to tumor growth and redox stress ([Kong 2020](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/molecular-biosciences/articles/10.3389/fmolb.2020.00153/full)).

**DECR2 ([Lipid Breakdown](#/mechanisms/lipid-breakdown)):** a second peroxisomal fatty-acid oxidation enzyme prostate tumors use to fuel growth and resist androgen-deprivation (hormone) therapy ([Mah 2024](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41416-023-02557-8)).

parts.label: Colorectal cancer
parts.text: the fatty acid transporter PMP70 helps drug-resistant colorectal tumors survive treatment ([Yin 2025](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41419-025-07572-6)).

parts.label: Lymphoma
parts.text: peroxisomes buffer chemotherapy-induced free radicals, helping tumor cells survive otherwise lethal treatment ([Dahabieh 2017](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5635217/)).

parts.label: Glioblastoma
parts.text: included per the reference document; specific peroxisomal mechanism not yet detailed here — open item.
